title: ValueFlow: Measuring the Propagation of Value Perturbations in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
reasoning: The paper develops a framework (ValueFlow) and a dataset to benchmark how human values, including spiritual dimensions (e.g., 'A Spiritual Life', 'Devout') and ethical orientations (e.g., 'Forgiving', 'Tradition'), propagate and shift within multi-agent LLM systems using the Schwartz Value Survey.
